description: This Python source file implements a plugin class `DeltaArmPlugin` for controlling Delta ARM robots, conforming to the Delta API specification. It includes functions for movement commands, point management, speed/acceleration control, digital I/O, timing, and Modbus communication, along with legacy support.

classes.name: DeltaArmPlugin
classes.description: A plugin class providing control functions for Delta ARM robots, including movement, digital I/O, speed/acceleration, and Modbus communication, with support for legacy functions.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] MovP(self, point: Union[int, str], **kwargs)
methods.description: Moves the robot to a specified point in point-to-point mode, optionally applying offsets.

methods.description: Performs linear movement to a specified point, optionally applying offsets.
